newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yoshitomi, Green Cross ask-only after merger news.
newsitem.headline: Yoshitomi, Green Cross ask-only after merger news.

text.p: Shares of pharmaceutical firms Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd and Green Cross Corp, which unveiled plans to merge on Monday, were ask-only on Tuesday morning.
As of 0029 GMT, Yoshitomi shares were ask-only at 880 yen, after finishing at 890 yen on the previous day. Green Cross Corp was ask-only at 556 yen after ending at 566 yen on Monday.
"Their shares are ask-only in anticipation of the share-price adjustment, which is due to take place," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"As far as Yoshitomi is concerned, the firm is rescuing Green Cross and some investors don't like the idea of the added financial burden," he added.
The firms said they would merge on October 1 and Green Cross, hurt by a scandal involving HIV-tainted blood products, be dissolved.
They said five shares of Green Cross will be exchanged for three Yoshitomi shares.
The merged company is expected to have sales of 150 billion yen and parent current profits of 14.5 billion yen in the fiscal year ending in March 1998, the companies said.
